scope.flow: Fill-or-Kill (FOK) order processing with lot-size rounding in _processFillBidOrder/_processFillAskOrder
scope.environment: Order-matching contract implementing FOK orders with lot-size rounding

entities.name: Order-matching contract with FOK fill logic

statements.text: The caller posts a FOK buy order whose baseAmount is 1.005 × lotSize, which is not an exact multiple of lotSize.
Internal rounding floor(amount / lotSize) * lotSize leaves a 0.005 × lotSize dust remainder greater than zero.
Because newOrder.amount > 0 after rounding, the code executes revert FOKOrderNotFilled() in both _processFillBidOrder and _processFillAskOrder.
A FOK order should still succeed with dust remaining unfilled so long as the filled amount is at least the requested amount minus dust.
For a FOK buy of 1.005 × lotSize, the order should fill the 1×lot and ignore the dust, returning success with dust unfilled.
FOK orders whose sizes are not lot-aligned should not revert solely due to a positive dust remainder.

ambiguities: Report does not state whether the caller is authorized or permissionless; no unauthorized-caller condition asserted.
No explicit action fragment beyond the caller posting the order; the revert is described as the code's behavior rather than a distinct attacker action.
Report does not specify whether the dust remainder is computed before or during matching, only that rounding occurs internally.
